references.text: Mentions cities of refuge that were to be given to the Levites, which is why Golan is mentioned as a city of refuge.
Mentions Golan in Bashan as one of the cities of refuge, the same city assigned here to the Gershonites.
Lists Golan in Bashan as one of the chosen cities of refuge for anyone who killed someone accidentally.
Parallel passage in Chronicles that mentions the cities given to the descendants of Gershon.
Mentions Golan and Ashtaroth (Beestara) as cities in half of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
Describes the clans of the Gershonites and their service, which is why they receive cities.
